Name: PPJA - Official Resource Collection
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sbKIn2g.png[/img]﻿

Includes documentation for modders. Template for all types of objects added via Json Assets. This mod does not add any content on it's own.

As of 9/6/2021 this documentation is outdated in favor of using DGA. DGA templates may be coming soon on their own separate mod page but it will take a bit. You may still use these to create JsonAssets items but users should make packs for DGA now.
